Notes.Text:
This update for libX11 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-88806: XkbGetMap Reply Heap-based Buffer Overflow (bsc#1280910).
- CVE-2026-94283: out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libX11's XIM (X Input Method) attribute parser (bsc#1281653).
- CVE-2026-94284: out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libX11's XIM trigger-keyregistration parser.registration parser
  (bsc#1281657).
- CVE-2026-94285: out-of-bounds read in libX11's byte-oriented codeset parser (bsc#1281661).
